Hello Doctor, I am 22 years old, and I have been experiencing recurring acne problems, mainly on both my cheeks. My skin is slightly oily and produces excess oil. Currently, I have red, inflamed pimples, some of which contain white or yellow pus. Some pimples are slightly painful when touched, and a few have developed crusts or scabs. I also have post-acne marks, dark spots, and uneven skin tone. My main concerns are: • Recurrent pimples on both cheeks • Redness and inflammation • White or yellow pus-filled pimples • Pain or tenderness when touching some pimples • Crusted lesions on a few pimples • Post-acne marks and dark spots • Uneven skin tone and skin texture • Excess oil production I would like to understand what type of acne I have and how severe my condition is. I am also concerned about preventing further breakouts, pigmentation, and permanent acne scars. Could you please recommend a suitable skincare routine for my skin type, including: 1. A suitable face wash or cleanser for oily, acne-prone skin. 2. An effective acne treatment for my inflamed and pus-filled pimples. 3. A suitable moisturizer that will not clog my pores. 4. A good sunscreen suitable for oily, acne-prone skin that can also help prevent dark spots from becoming worse. 5. A treatment for post-acne marks and uneven skin tone. 6. A proper morning and nighttime skincare routine, including how often to use each product. Please also advise whether I need any prescription medication or an in-person consultation for my current acne condition. I would prefer a simple, effective, and affordable skincare routine with products suitable for my skin type. Pls rly mam
